t: The LAP LED tube starter is a reliable electrical component specifically designed for T8 LED tube lights. It ensures efficient and consistent operation for new or replacement LED lighting installations. Suitable for both domestic and commercial indoor environments, this starter is ideal for workshops, offices, and utility rooms. It has a 6-24W power rating and a 220-240V supply, performing effectively across a wide temperature range of -15 to 40 °C. Its compact dimensions, measuring L38.5 x D21mm, allow for straightforward integration into existing fittings.
b: Designed Exclusively for LED Tube Lights
